protocol.purpose: Corrected second-item-bank replication of the four-arm comparison (full SM / E-only / simplified SM without pair-mixed outputs / fixed-budget maxent k=3). Fixes F1/F2 data errors; text/family names are disjoint from v5/v4 but some structures overlap. Sensitivity/replication only; no threshold changes.

arms.full_sm: frozen v5 stability_mixed (posterior + E + LR + pair_guard + extra-none + pair/mixed terminals)
arms.e_only: posterior + E gate only; no LR, no pair guard, no pair/mixed terminals, no extra-none
arms.simplified_sm: full single gate + explicit none + extra none; pair/mixed terminals disabled
arms.fixed3: maxent selection, exactly 3 additional inquiries, posterior terminal without pairs

R1_full_sm_vs_fixed3.note: fixed3 has no adaptive correct-stop (N/A); stable_correct is the substantive stable-accuracy comparison.

R2_e_only_vs_fixed3.note: fixed3 has no adaptive correct-stop (N/A); stable_correct is the substantive stable-accuracy comparison.

prior_gate.note: Report category-conditioned prior top-1/top-10 recall on v6. If top-10 recall < 0.90, interpret arm results as prior-limited and do not tune prompts on v6 outcomes.

protocol.claim_boundary: Replication on a corrected second programmatically authored item bank. Text and family names do not overlap with v5 test+dev, but several structures do (reported in v6b_data_audit.json). This is a second-bank / partial-structural-extension check, not a strict unseen-structure holdout, external holdout, or risk certification.

out_of_scope_structures.frac_add_three/ignore_denominators: library accepts two fractions; three-fraction extension verified independently
out_of_scope_structures.frac_mul_three/ignore_denominators: library's ignore-denominators rule reads only the first two fractions; three-fraction extension verified independently
out_of_scope_structures.frac_compare_four/denominator_comparison: library supports at most three fractions; four-way comparison verified independently
out_of_scope_structures.frac_compare_four/natural_number_bias_nu: library supports at most three fractions; four-way comparison verified independently
out_of_scope_structures.pct_find_whole/percent_equals_decimal: library's percent_equals_decimal covers percent-of-value, not find-whole; independent formula verified
out_of_scope_structures.pct_compare_change/reverse_percentage_er: library's reverse_percentage_error covers 'p% as much' comparison statements, not the larger/smaller asymmetry used here; independent formula verified

structural_overlap_with_v5.definition: category + operation + arity + normalized text skeleton + category-specific structure (subtraction borrow profile; fraction arity/common denominator; decimal places; OO operator sequence/parentheses; percentage template). Coarse diagnostic, not a proof of uniqueness.
